qa.title: Q639 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, do effects which target followers apply to it?
qa.answer: No. Only effects which target amulets apply to it.

qa.title: Q638 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet and then it evolves, does it trigger Mini Soul Devil's "Whenever one of your followers evolves" ability?
qa.answer: No. It's an amulet, not a follower, so it doesn't trigger Mini Soul Devil's ability when it evolves.

qa.title: Q637 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If Mordecai the Duelist's card type is changed to amulet, then it's put into the cemetery, and I put it back onto my field with its Last Words ability, is it still an amulet?
qa.answer: No. When a card is moved from the field to a different zone, it's considered to be a new card and loses any effects applied to it when it was on the field.

qa.title: Q636 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower with Ward has its card type changed to amulet, do enemy followers have to attack it when it's engaged?
qa.answer: No. Amulets can't be attacked.

qa.title: Q635 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If Diamond Master's card type is changed to amulet, do opponents still need to select it when selecting followers for an ability?
qa.answer: No. Since Diamond Master is an amulet, it can't be selected when selecting followers. However, if an opponent is selecting cards for an ability like Execution's, which can select amulets, they must select Diamond Master.

qa.title: Q634 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet and then it's evolved/raced, do its On Evolve/On Race abilities trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, they do.

qa.title: Q633 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, can it still be served and raced?
qa.answer: Yes. Note that even if raced, it remains an amulet.

qa.title: Q632 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, can it still evolve?
qa.answer: Yes. Note that even if evolved, it remains an amulet.

qa.title: Q631 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower with a Last Words ability has its card type changed to amulet and is put into the cemetery, does its Last Words ability trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.title: Q630 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, can its attack and defense values be referenced?
qa.answer: No. It still possesses attack and defense values, but you treat the card as if it doesn't have them, and they can't be referenced by abilities.

qa.title: Q629 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, can it attack?
qa.answer: No. Amulets can't attack, be attacked, or take damage.

qa.title: Q628 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, does it lose all abilities?
qa.answer:
No. All its abilities remain valid. This includes activated abilities, evolve abilities, and Last Words abilities.

For example, if you change a Water Fairy's card type to amulet with this follower's ability, it becomes an amulet named Water Fairy with the following three abilities: "{icon_evolve|evolve} {icon_cost02|cost02}: Evolve this follower"; "{icon_act|act} {icon_cost02|cost02}: Put this card into its owner's cemetery"; and "{icon_lastword|lastword} Put a Fairy token into your EX area." If it gets put into the cemetery, with its new activated ability or otherwise, its Last Words ability triggers as usual.

qa.title: Q663 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If my opponent's deck is empty, and I make them put the top card of their deck into their cemetery, do I win the game?
qa.answer: No. If you draw a card when your deck is empty, you lose the game. If you put the top card of your deck into your cemetery when your deck is empty, nothing happens.

qa.title: Q655 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: Can you explain this follower's activated ability in detail?
qa.answer:
If you can select a card in an opponent's cemetery, you can pay 8 play points to play this follower's activated ability, by which you play the selected card for 0 play points.

If you selected a follower or amulet, you put it onto your field and play any Fanfare abilities it has. When it moves to a zone other than the field, it moves to the corresponding zone of its owner. Cards put onto your field with this follower's ability are generally treated in the same way as stolen cards. See the Q&A for Angel of Chaos (BP03-109EN) for more details.

If you selected a spell, you resolve its abilities, then put it back into its owner's cemetery.

qa.title: Q654 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If I play Dimension Shift with this follower's activated ability, do I put it back into my opponent's cemetery after resolving it?
qa.answer: Yes, you do.

qa.title: Q653 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: Can I select and play 7 More Centimeters with this follower's activated ability?
qa.answer: It depends. First, you can select 7 More Centimeters from an opponent's cemetery. Then, if you have at least 20 Umamusume cards in your cemetery, you can play it for 0 play points. If not, you can't play it, and nothing else happens.

qa.title: Q656 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: Can you explain this follower's On Evolve ability in detail?
qa.answer:
When playing this follower's On Evolve ability, you select a card in an opponent's cemetery and put it into your EX area.

If you selected a follower or amulet, you can put it onto your field by playing it like any other card, or with abilities that put a card from your EX area onto your field.

If you selected a spell, you can play it like any other card. After resolving its abilities, you put the spell back into its owner's cemetery.

After the card is put into your EX area, if it should move to a zone other than the field, it moves to the corresponding zone of its owner.

{icon_fanfare|[fanfare]} {icon_cost03|[cost03]}: Search your deck for an Apostle of Craving and Craving's Splendor, put them into your EX area, then shuffle your deck.
{icon_fanfare|[fanfare]} If each player has 10 maximum play points, draw 3 cards.
Whenever you play a {icon_neutral|[neutral]} card, deal 1 damage to each enemy leader.

qa.title: Q731 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If I play Apostle of Craving from my EX area, does this follower's "Whenever you play a Neutral card" ability trigger?
qa.answer: Yes. Playing a Neutral card (tokens included) from any zone, whether it be your hand, EX area, or cemetery, triggers this follower's ability. However, note that evolving a follower doesn't count as playing a card.

qa.title: Q730 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If I play this follower, does its own "Whenever you play a Neutral card" ability trigger?
qa.answer: No. When you play this follower, it's not on your field yet, so its abilities aren't valid.

qa.title: Q729 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: Can I choose the order in which I resolve this follower's two Fanfare abilities?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.title: Q728 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If I put Lucifer onto my field with Death's Breath while this follower is on my field, does this follower's "Whenever you play a Neutral card" ability trigger?
qa.answer: No. "Putting" a card onto your field with an ability isn't the same as playing it.

qa.title: Q727 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If I don't have a Craving's Splendor in my deck, can I still search for an Apostle of Craving and put it into my EX area with this follower's Fanfare ability?
qa.answer: Yes. Note that even if you do have a Craving's Splendor in your deck, you can choose to not find it.

qa.title: Q726 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If I play a Neutral card and deal 1 damage to the enemy leader with this follower's ability, does my leader get +1 defense from Drain?
qa.answer: No. Drain only triggers when this follower deals attack damage, not ability damage.
